diagnostics.message: capabilities of this Pack declare 2 different refusal floors: "order.default.deny" (conformance.terminal.floor-a); "order.default.refuse" (conformance.terminal.floor-b). A Pack has exactly one PolicyBundle.default basis code, so at most one of these can be right — the others mis-declare where their capability's fall-through REFUSE lands.
